decks.notes: The main concept of this Dimir Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. By utilizing cards like Spyglass Siren, Kaito Bane of Nightmares, and Floodpits Drowner, the deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. With a combination of cheap removal spells like Go for the Throat and disruptive cards like Hopeless Nightmare, the deck aims to keep the opponent on their toes and prevent them from establishing a strong board presence. This deck is all about applying pressure and staying ahead in the race for victory.

The main concept of this Jeskai Aggro deck is to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggressive creatures and powerful instant and sorcery spells. Gleeful Demolition and Protect the Negotiators provide additional removal and disruption to help push through for the win.
